explanation: Charges actual physical terminal tests to raw incidence mass and frontier overhead. The original-value enumerations preserve source identities, so terminal bucket products are charged to the corresponding raw incidences.
theorem_title: Terminal frontier time is charged to raw incidences
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostTerminalFrontier.frontier_time_le {h J k NL NR : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (shift : ℤ)
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) (C : Finset γ) (a : α→ℤ) (b : β→ℤ) (c : γ→ℤ)
    (left right : ℕ→ℤ) (eL : Fin NL ≃ B) (eR : Fin NR ≃ C)
    (hvL : ∀ i : Fin NL, left i.val=b (eL i)) (hvR : ∀ j : Fin NR, right j.val=c (eR j))
    (w : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.Wanted h J α) (hk : k≤J)
    (hkey : w.1∈A ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalEncoding.globalModulus h J ∣ (a w.1%(p : ℤ)+_root_.ThreeSum.RawIncidences.lift w.2.1*(p : ℤ)+shift)-_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalEncoding.globalKey w.2.2) :
    let I := _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawIncidences.rawOn h J (p : ℤ) shift (A ×ˢ (B ×ˢ C)) a b c
    let pres := _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostFrontier.frontier I w k
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostTerminalFrontier.time p shift left right NL NR w.2.2 k pres pres.length≤
      240*(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.domain I w).card+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostTerminalFrontier.charge h J k*pres.length+30 := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let finite source sets $A,B,C$ have integer value functions, with actual left and right arrays bijective to $B,C$ and preserving those values. Fix a wanted label whose $A$ component is in $A$ and whose shifted lifted key satisfies the required global divisibility condition. At any depth $k\le J$, for the corresponding raw-incidence set $I$ and actual frontier $F$, $$T_{\mathrm{terminal}}\le240|\operatorname{domain}(I,w)|+\operatorname{charge}(h,J,k)|F|+30.$$

Charges actual physical terminal tests to raw incidence mass and frontier overhead. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
